column1: # 1st SS Leibstandarte Division\PG2_readme.txt · 译文填写表：只改第三列（译文），其余别动

column2: Meine Ehre heisst Treue - 1st SS 'Leibstandarte Adolf Hitler' Division
column3: 我的荣誉即忠诚 - 党卫军第1"警卫旗队"师(Leibstandarte Adolf Hitler)

column2: The reason for this campaign is not to endorse, glorify or promote Nazism/Fascism.  I am deeply opposed to such views and consider them abhorrant in the extreme.  That being said, one can not deny the fighting abilities or grit and fanatacism of this certain divsion of the Waffen SS.  I merely wish to tell the story of one of the most interesting and controversial units of the Second World War, and to try and immerse the player into the battle's represented.  As well as detailing the fighting exploits of the Leibstandarte, I have included at certain points of the campaign details of attrocities carried out by Leibstandarte members.  This is done to give a sense of perspective.  I hope you enjoy the campaign.
column3: 本战役的用意并非赞同、美化或宣扬纳粹主义/法西斯主义。我本人强烈反对这类观点，并认为它们极其可憎。话虽如此，谁也无法否认武装党卫军这个师的战斗力、胆魄与狂热。我只是想讲述二战中最有意思也最具争议的单位之一的故事，并尽量让玩家沉浸到所描绘的战斗之中。在详述警卫旗队作战事迹的同时，我也在战役的某些节点写入了警卫旗队成员所犯暴行的细节。这样做是为了提供一种参照。希望你喜欢这个战役。

column2: You can play the campaign with or without rules.  For a better challenge you should play with rules, though.  If playing with rules you will keep the historical core by following the instructions in the scenario intro files.
column3: 你可以按规则游玩本战役，也可以不按规则。不过，想更有挑战性，就应当按规则游玩。若按规则游玩，只要遵照场景介绍文件中的说明，就能保持历史核心。
